qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
A person who hates mankind
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
A person who hates mankind
e: A 'misanthrope' dislikes or distrusts humankind; a 'philanthropist' loves and helps humanity.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
A handwriting that cannot be read easily
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
A handwriting that cannot be read easily
e: 'Illegible' means not clear enough to be read.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
An animal that feeds on both plants and meat
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
An animal that feeds on both plants and meat
e: An 'omnivore' eats food of both plant and animal origin.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
A life history written by oneself
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
A life history written by oneself
e: An 'autobiography' is an account of a person's life written by that person.

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: BENEVOLENT
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: BENEVOLENT
e: 'Benevolent' means well-meaning and kindly.

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: OBSTINATE
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: OBSTINATE
e: 'Obstinate' means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or action.

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: FRUGAL
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: FRUGAL
e: 'Frugal' means sparing or economical with money or food.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: COURAGEOUS
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: COURAGEOUS
e: 'Courageous' means brave; its opposite is 'Cowardly'.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: ANCIENT
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: ANCIENT
e: 'Ancient' relates to the distant past; 'Modern' relates to present or recent times.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: GENEROUS
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: GENEROUS
e: 'Generous' means willing to give freely; 'Stingy' means unwilling to spend or give.

qe:
Select the meaning of the idiom:
To turn a deaf ear
qh:
दिए गए मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
To turn a deaf ear
oe: To refuse to listen or ignore
oh: To refuse to listen or ignore
e: 'Turn a deaf ear' means to deliberately ignore what someone says.

qe:
Select the meaning of the idiom:
A piece of cake
qh:
दिए गए मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
A piece of cake
e: 'A piece of cake' describes a task that is effortless or very easy.

qe:
Select the meaning of the idiom:
Bite the bullet
qh:
दिए गए मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
Bite the bullet
oe: Face a difficult situation with courage
oh: Face a difficult situation with courage
e: 'Bite the bullet' means to endure a painful or difficult situation bravely.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
The police are looking ______ the theft reported last night.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
The police are looking ______ the theft reported last night.
e: 'Look into' means to investigate.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
No sooner did the bell ring ______ the students rushed out.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
No sooner did the bell ring ______ the students rushed out.
e: 'No sooner' is always paired with 'than'.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
Each of the applicants ______ submitted the required documents.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
Each of the applicants ______ submitted the required documents.
e: 'Each of + plural noun' takes a singular verb ('has').

qe:
Fill in the blank:
He is confident ______ winning the gold medal this year.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
He is confident ______ winning the gold medal this year.
e: 'Confident' takes the preposition 'of'.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
Please ______ the lights before leaving the office.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
Please ______ the lights before leaving the office.
e: 'Turn off' means to switch off an electrical appliance or light.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
______ you work hard, you will not succeed.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
______ you work hard, you will not succeed.
e: 'Unless' expresses the negative condition 'if not'.

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
He returned back (A) / from Delhi (B) / last week. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
He returned back (A) / from Delhi (B) / last week. (C) / No error (D)
e: 'Return' already means 'come back', so 'returned back' is superfluous; use 'He returned'.

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
She is more taller (A) / than her sister (B) / by two inches. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
She is more taller (A) / than her sister (B) / by two inches. (C) / No error (D)
e: Double comparatives are incorrect; remove 'more' to write 'She is taller'.

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
I look forward (A) / to meet you (B) / next month. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
I look forward (A) / to meet you (B) / next month. (C) / No error (D)
e: 'Look forward to' takes a gerund (-ing form): 'to meeting you'.

qe:
Improve the bracketed part:
If it (will rain), we will cancel the picnic.
qh:
कोष्ठक में दिए गए भाग को सुधारिए:
If it (will rain), we will cancel the picnic.
e: In First Conditional sentences, the 'if'-clause takes Simple Present ('rains'), not 'will'.

qe:
Convert into Passive Voice:
Someone has stolen my bicycle.
qh:
दिए गए वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलिए:
Someone has stolen my bicycle.
e: Present Perfect active ('has stolen') converts to 'has been + V3' ('has been stolen'); vague agent 'someone' is omitted.

qe:
Convert into Indirect Speech:
He said, "Bravo! You have played well."
qh:
दिए गए वाक्य को Indirect Speech में बदलिए:
He said, "Bravo! You have played well."
oe: He congratulated him that he plays well.
He asked if he had played well.
He applauded him saying that he had played well.
He shouted that he played well.
oh: He congratulated him that he plays well.
He asked if he had played well.
He applauded him saying that he had played well.
He shouted that he played well.
e: 'Bravo!' expresses applause/praise, converting to 'applauded ... saying that' with tense backshifted to Past Perfect.

qe: Find the word with the correct spelling:
qh: शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द ज्ञात कीजिए:
e: 'Separate' is spelt S-E-P-A-R-A-T-E (with an 'a' in the middle).

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (1):
Discipline is the bridge between goals and (1)____. Without a steady routine, even talented individuals may (2)____ to achieve their full potential. Developing good habits early in life builds self-confidence and helps a person stay (3)____ during difficult (4)____.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (1) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Discipline is the bridge between goals and (1)____. Without a steady routine, even talented individuals may (2)____ to achieve their full potential. Developing good habits early in life builds self-confidence and helps a person stay (3)____ during difficult (4)____.
e: Discipline connects goals to 'accomplishment' (achievement).

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (2):
Discipline is the bridge between goals and (1)____. Without a steady routine, even talented individuals may (2)____ to achieve their full potential. Developing good habits early in life builds self-confidence and helps a person stay (3)____ during difficult (4)____.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (2) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Discipline is the bridge between goals and (1)____. Without a steady routine, even talented individuals may (2)____ to achieve their full potential. Developing good habits early in life builds self-confidence and helps a person stay (3)____ during difficult (4)____.
e: Without a routine, talented people may 'struggle' to reach their potential.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (3):
Discipline is the bridge between goals and (1)____. Without a steady routine, even talented individuals may (2)____ to achieve their full potential. Developing good habits early in life builds self-confidence and helps a person stay (3)____ during difficult (4)____.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (3) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Discipline is the bridge between goals and (1)____. Without a steady routine, even talented individuals may (2)____ to achieve their full potential. Developing good habits early in life builds self-confidence and helps a person stay (3)____ during difficult (4)____.
e: Good habits help a person stay 'focused'.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (4):
Discipline is the bridge between goals and (1)____. Without a steady routine, even talented individuals may (2)____ to achieve their full potential. Developing good habits early in life builds self-confidence and helps a person stay (3)____ during difficult (4)____.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (4) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Discipline is the bridge between goals and (1)____. Without a steady routine, even talented individuals may (2)____ to achieve their full potential. Developing good habits early in life builds self-confidence and helps a person stay (3)____ during difficult (4)____.
e: 'During difficult times' is the standard idiomatic expression.
